contest.title: THE PUSH
contest.outcome.withdrew.title: The other side gave up.
contest.outcome.broke.title: Yours gave up first.
contest.outcome.limit.title: Nobody gave up today.
contest.outcome.withdrew.body: They leave by the same road they came in on. The wall is still where it was, and so are you.
contest.outcome.broke.body: They pull back anyway, late. What was half-done on your stretch is loose stone again; what was already standing is still standing. Tomorrow it gets laid again.
contest.outcome.limit.body: The whole day went by without either side giving way. They leave tired, and they come back whenever they like.
contest.move.watch.spent_note: They have seen the torch once already, and they don't look twice.
contest.log.page_unlocked: The wall is still standing, and now there is one more way to answer.
contest.log.hold.built: Nobody moves. The stretch you raised takes the push.
contest.log.hold.bare: Nobody moves. Behind you the wall is still an idea.
contest.log.call.answered: You call, and the ones who know you by name answer.
contest.log.call.unanswered: You call. On your side nobody knows who is calling.
contest.log.watch.spent: The same torch, the same path. The other side has already counted it.
contest.log.watch.posted: The torch runs the top of the wall end to end, and there are people at each end.
contest.log.watch.unposted: The torch runs a short stretch. There isn't much to show.
contest.log.half_and_half: They expected one thing or the other. They find both.
contest.log.enemy.1: On the other side they come forward a few steps and stop, so you can count how many they are.
contest.log.enemy.2: They beat spear on shield, in time, without moving from where they stand.
contest.log.enemy.3: A stone hits the top of the wall. Nobody is hurt, and that is exactly what wears you down.
contest.log.enemy.4: They shout all day without attacking. Some of yours look towards the road home.
contest.log.enemy.5: One of them points at the lowest stretch and laughs. Not yours; the one nobody is watching.
contest.log.enemy.6: They stop shouting all at once. Their silence is the part your people can least stand.
contest.log.enemy.7: They come two steps down off the ridge and go back. They are timing how long you take to answer.
contest.log.enemy.8: A rider leaves by the upper road in no hurry. Gone to tell someone what he saw.
contest.log.letters.1: Another messenger arrives with the same letter and the same date on it. Nobody goes down to take it.
contest.log.letters.2: Someone reads the open letter aloud in the lower square. It isn't for you to hear; it's for your people to hear.
contest.log.letters.3: Word goes round that the work has stopped from the inside. Two men on the afternoon shift come to ask whether it is true.
contest.log.letters.4: They repeat the invitation a fourth time, more politely each time. It is the politeness that wears you down.
contest.log.end.withdrew: The other side pulls back. Nobody comes down off the wall to go after them.
contest.log.end.broke: Yours let go of the line, and the other side pulls back anyway, late. What was half-done on your stretch is loose stone again; what was already standing is still standing.
contest.log.end.limit: They tire before you do and leave without saying anything.
contest.mockery.title: THE MOCKERY
contest.mockery.outcome.withdrew.title: They ran out of things to say.
contest.mockery.outcome.broke.title: Your people stopped listening to you.
contest.mockery.outcome.limit.title: They went hoarse.
contest.mockery.outcome.withdrew.body: Nobody over there is laughing any more. They stay on the upper road, talking among themselves, lower, and the course you counted stays counted.
contest.mockery.outcome.broke.body: They tire and stop shouting, late. What was half done on your stretch is on the ground for want of hands; what was standing is still standing. Tomorrow it is laid again.
contest.mockery.outcome.limit.body: The whole day passed. They ran out of voice and are still up there, quiet, and the work neither stopped nor sped up on their account.
contest.log.keep_counting: Nine, ten, eleven. On the other side somebody notices that nobody is listening.
contest.log.mockery.1: On the upper road the man from Samaria talks to the men he brought, loud enough for the wind to carry it. It is not you he is talking to.
contest.log.mockery.2: They ask, laughing, whether you will be finished today. Some of yours look at the stretch and do the sum.
contest.log.mockery.3: One of them picks a burnt stone off the heap and lets it drop. The noise is the whole argument.
contest.log.mockery.4: The Ammonite tells the joke about the fox. He laughs alone for a while, and then the others join in.
contest.log.mockery.5: They stop for a drink. The silence is worse: it leaves time to repeat to yourself what was said.
contest.log.mockery.6: Two of yours put the stone down and go a little way down to hear better. They do not leave; they just stop.
contest.famine.title: THE FAMINE
contest.famine.outcome.withdrew.title: They gave it back.
contest.famine.outcome.broke.title: Your people went home hungry.
contest.famine.outcome.limit.title: Nobody gave way today.
contest.famine.outcome.withdrew.body: The ones who were charging promised to give it back, in front of everybody, and the promise was written down. Tomorrow there will still be hunger; today it stopped growing.
contest.famine.outcome.broke.body: They left the wall in the middle of the day, each to see to their own table. What was half done on your stretch is on the ground; what was standing is still standing. Tomorrow it is laid again.
contest.famine.outcome.limit.body: The day went by in the meeting, and nobody promised anything. The fields stay mortgaged and the work stays standing. Both at once.
contest.log.keep_building: One more course. Over there nobody stops shouting because of it.
contest.log.give_back: You say, in front of everyone, what you give back. The silence afterwards belongs to whoever had no answer.
contest.log.refuse_ration: Your share goes to another table. Whoever saw it tells whoever did not.
contest.log.famine.1: It does not come from outside. It comes from the lower square: people from the work complaining about people from the work.
contest.log.famine.2: A woman says how many children she has and how much grain is missing. The numbers add up, and that is what hurts.
contest.log.famine.3: Somebody mortgaged the vineyard to eat this month. Somebody else mortgaged the house to pay the king's tax.
contest.log.famine.4: A father speaks quietly of a daughter who went to work in the house of a man from here, to pay a grain debt. Nobody on the wall answers.
contest.log.famine.5: The ones who lend are in the same square. They do not shout. They wait for the subject to pass.
contest.log.famine.6: Two of yours come down off the wall to the meeting. They have not left the work: it is that the work fills no plate.

welcome.title: Back.
welcome.grace: Nothing moved without you, and nothing went backwards. The wall is where you left it.
vocation.headline: The door is hung.
vocation.body: The wall goes the whole way round now, and your stretch is the one that closes it. Nobody has to raise this again.
vocation.record.anonymous: This stretch was repaired by you.
vocation.reveal.fallback_name: The one who stayed to the end.
vocation.reveal.fallback_line: The stretch stands, and so does what you did to raise it.

world.progress_map.objective.heading: OBJECTIVE
world.progress_map.objective.1: Answer the summons: choose who you are on the work, and lay the first stone before dark.
world.progress_map.objective.2: Meet the people beside you on the wall, answer the invitation from the plain, and leave no night unwatched.
world.progress_map.objective.3: Keep laying, and decide whether an hour of your day goes to the people of Tekoa or stays on your stretch.
world.progress_map.objective.4: A day of rest: gather the people and hear what each of them has to say before the work weighs.
world.progress_map.objective.5: Lay stone under the mockery from the ridge, and choose whether to clear the path with the carriers.
world.progress_map.objective.6: Hold the work when the attack comes from outside, without dropping the stone or leaving the wall.
world.progress_map.objective.7: Answer the hunger that comes from inside, and pay from your own day what only you can give.
world.progress_map.objective.8: Close the last course of the stretch, and go down to no letter.
world.progress_map.objective.9: Raise the gate on the stretch that is yours, and dedicate the wall with the whole city.

dialogue.history.title: What was said
help.step.talk: Tap somebody in the village. People answer, and what they tell you changes what you know how to do.
help.step.gather: The rubble piles turn into material. Tap one to pick it up.
help.step.build: Tap a stretch of the wall to raise it with the material you are carrying. The day's work is limited.
help.step.read: Every citation carries Learn more. It opens the whole chapter, in here, and you come back where you left off.
help.step.rest: To stop before the work runs out, the mat by your door ends the day. When the work runs out, the day ends by itself.
help.step.split: Ending the day, you split who works and who keeps watch. Both matter.
help.step.trial: On the third day the village is put to the test. What was said there is what you have to answer with.
